PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
ACCA-qualified accountant with 8 years of experience: 4 years in external audit
with a mid-tier firm in Dubai, followed by 4 years in group financial reporting
for a diversified holding company. Prepares IFRS consolidated financial
statements for a group of 14 entities, leads the month-end and year-end close,
and manages the statutory audit relationship. Comfortable with IFRS 15, IFRS 16
and IFRS 9, intercompany eliminations, UAE VAT returns and the new UAE Corporate
Tax regime. Fluent English; basic Arabic.
